title: The Trees That Drop Every Leaf

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A gardener wonders whether in some distant land the trees might drop all their leaves at once and stand bare until they grow back.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a gardener, wonders whether in some distant land the trees might drop all their leaves at once and stand bare until they grow back.

choices.label: Ask Whether It Could Happen Here.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A child imagines bare trees and feels sorry for them.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An elder suggests the people there might find it beautiful, like a rest before new growth.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A scholar wonders whether whole seasons might pass in ways Isolans have never seen.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A farmer wonders how anyone would plan a harvest with such changes.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The village looks at Isola's evergreen trees and decides it probably will not.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A gardener notices one tree that does drop most of its leaves and becomes fascinated.
